title: 第十五章 姐她馋我身子第十六章 镇北王府这么荤素不拘的
content_zh:
“凉州分舵？他哪里得罪了世安？”
段擎岳疑惑道。
他还是认为白宣应当先回宣武郡。
虽说白宣法定的继承人，但这种事情，迟则生变。
最好是先继承。
至于血影教，不过是跳梁小丑，日后再解决便是。
“日前，我和娘遭遇血影教刺杀，我玉真观上下数十口人包括我之手足，尽数殒命。现查证是听血影教凉州分舵舵主之命，大舅，你觉得他们该活着吗？”听到段擎岳颇有抗拒之意，白宣目光中带着几分凌厉地看向段擎岳道。
“该死。”
段擎岳闻言，心中顿时一凛。
一旁的秋临渊闻言，面色微变，道：“北境武林，归我统率，这是在下的过失，还请王妃和公子恕罪！”
藏剑山庄，北境第一门派，除却藏剑世家本身强大之外，更关键的是镇北王府背后扶持。
作为回报，藏剑山庄负责维持北境武林的太平。
如今出了这样的事，往大了说，是他藏剑山庄无能。
偏生又是镇北王世子惨死，镇北王生死不明，整个北境都即将迎来一场权力风暴的关口。
“秋庄主不必自责，血影教并非北境势力，本是魔道，防不胜防。”段白语反倒主动为秋临渊辩解。
有光明便有阴暗。
藏剑山庄虽是镇北王府在北境江湖的延伸，但要说剿灭北境一切阴暗势力，那本身就是强人所难。
再者，血影教要出手，北境无人，无非就是从其余地方调遣人手。
魔门四宗至今没有被灭，最关键的原因就在于，没有人知道他们的总坛在哪儿。
有的说是在北荒，有的说是在江南。

“此事我难辞其咎，西凉铁骑固然举世无双，但大军行动声势浩大，魔门中人素来以狡猾出名，可能让血影教的人警觉。不如我个人灵活，我即刻启程，先行一步，调动人马，围攻血影教分舵。”秋临渊道。
大军奔驰，总不如他一个人来得快。
而且魔门中人素来狡猾、谨慎，不能不防。
白宣闻言，眉头微皱，这的确是个问题，这年头能活着的魔门中人无不是狡猾、谨慎的，毕竟，不狡猾不谨慎的，活不到现在。
狡兔有三窟，然而魔门中人几窟谁也不知道。
“仲父，有舅父大军护佑，想来我们的安危可以确保，不如可否劳烦仲父和秋庄主一起去剿灭血影教凉州分舵，助秋庄主一臂之力，我等随后赶到。”白宣闻言，看向李道衍道。
“公子有命，自不敢不从，麻烦秋庄主了。”李道衍心知此事不解决，白宣和段白语心中便时时记挂，反倒耽误大事，当即领命。
“不敢当，有李先生相助，是晚辈的福分。”
秋临渊朝李道衍行礼，心中也是对此事更加上心。
若仅仅只是告知他血影教分舵所在，现在就可以告诉，却特意让李道衍陪同。
恐怕是防备他和血影教有勾结。
不过，虽察觉到了白宣的心思，秋临渊心中却无半分怨气，反倒松了口气。
一来，李道衍不是平庸之辈，神谋鬼算，精通阵法，真的可以帮助他，而不是来拖累他的；二来，也是更关键的，他能看出白宣很在意被杀的人，那么他若是活捉了凉州分舵舵主固然是大功一件，可若是出了什么好歹的话，便有理也说不清了。
藏剑山庄已是北境第一宗门，进无可进，秋临渊自然是不求有功，但求无过，李道衍在，反而更让他安心。
话音落下，秋临渊身后剑匣忽然打开，一声清脆剑鸣声响起，秋临渊腾空而起，脚踏飞剑，御剑而行。
李道衍则从怀中取出一罗盘来，罗盘之上青光涌现，浮现出巨大的八卦虚影，尔后整个人亦腾空而起，跟随秋临渊而去，消失在天际。
“世安不必担心，李先生和秋庄主一起去，定手到擒来，告慰逝者在天之灵。”段擎岳宽慰道。
content_en:
"Liangzhou branch? How did he offend Shi'an?"
Duan Qingyue said doubtfully.
He still believed that Bai Xuan should return to Xuanwu County first.
Although Bai Xuan is the legal heir, things like this will change later.
It's best to inherit first.
As for the Blood Shadow Sect, they are just clowns and will be dealt with later.
"A few days ago, my mother and I were assassinated by the Blood Shadow Sect. Dozens of people in my Yuzhen Temple, including my brothers and sisters, were all killed. Now it is confirmed that they were ordered by the leader of the Liangzhou Branch of the Blood Shadow Sect. Uncle, do you think they should live?" Hearing Duan Qingyue's resistance, Bai Xuan looked at Duan Qingyue with a sharp look in his eyes.
"Damn it."
When Duan Qingyue heard this, his heart suddenly froze.
Qiu Linyuan on the side changed slightly when he heard this, and said: "The martial arts in the north are under my command. This is my fault. Please forgive me, Princess and Young Master!"
Hidden Sword Villa is the number one sect in the north. In addition to the powerful Hidden Sword Family itself, what’s more important is the support behind it from Zhenbei Prince’s Palace.
In return, Hidden Sword Villa is responsible for maintaining peace in the martial arts forest in the north.
Now that something like this happened, to be honest, it was his incompetence at Hidden Sword Villa.
Unfortunately, the crown prince of Zhenbei died tragically again. The life and death of Prince Zhenbei was unknown, and the entire northern territory was about to usher in a power storm.
"Master Qiu, there is no need to blame yourself. The Blood Shadow Sect is not a force in the north. It is a demonic way and cannot be guarded against." Duan Baiyu took the initiative to defend Qiu Linyuan.
Where there is light there is darkness.
Although Hidden Sword Villa is an extension of the Zhenbei Palace in the northern realm, it is difficult to eliminate all the dark forces in the northern realm.
Furthermore, if the Blood Shadow Sect wants to take action, there is no one in the north, so they can only dispatch people from other places.
The four sects of the Demon Sect have not been destroyed so far. The most critical reason is that no one knows where their main altar is.
Some said it was in Beihuang, and some said it was in Jiangnan.
"I cannot blame myself for this matter. Although the Xiliang Iron Cavalry is unparalleled in the world, the movement of the army is huge, and the people in the Demon Sect are known for their cunning, which may alert the people of the Blood Shadow Sect. As I am not as flexible as myself, I will set off immediately, take the first step, mobilize people and horses, and besiege the Blood Shadow Sect's helm." Qiu Linyuan said.
A galloping army cannot come as fast as him alone.
Moreover, people in the Demon Sect have always been cunning and cautious, so they must be on guard.
Bai Xuan frowned slightly after hearing this. This is indeed a problem. The people in the Demon Sect who are alive these days are all cunning and cautious. After all, those who are not cunning and cautious will not survive now.
The cunning rabbit has three burrows, but no one knows how many burrows the people in the Demon Sect have.
"Father Zhong, we are protected by my uncle's army. I think our safety can be ensured. Why don't you bother Father Zhong and Lord Qiu to go together to annihilate the Liangzhou branch of the Blood Shadow Sect and help Lord Qiu. We will arrive soon." Bai Xuan heard this and looked at Li Daoyan.
"Young master has your destiny, I dare not disobey and trouble Lord Qiu." Li Daoyan knew that the matter would not be resolved, and Bai Xuan and Duan Baiyu would always worry about it. On the contrary, it would delay the important matter, so they immediately accepted the order.
"Don't take it seriously. It is a blessing for the younger generation to have Mr. Li to help."
Qiu Linyuan saluted Li Daoyan, and he was more concerned about this matter.
If he just told him the location of the Blood Shadow Sect's branch, he could tell him now, but he specifically asked Li Daoyan to accompany him.
I'm afraid it was to prevent him from colluding with the Blood Shadow Cult.
However, even though he was aware of Bai Xuan's thoughts, Qiu Linyuan did not feel any resentment in his heart, but instead breathed a sigh of relief.
Firstly, Li Daoyan is not a mediocre person. He is a scheming and proficient person who can really help him instead of dragging him down. Secondly, and more importantly, he can see that Bai Xuan cares about the people who were killed. So if he captured the leader of the Liangzhou branch alive, it would be a great achievement, but if something bad happened, it would be justified and unclear.
Hidden Sword Villa is already the number one sect in the north, and there is no way to enter it. Qiu Linyuan naturally does not seek merit, but seeks no faults. The presence of Li Daoyan makes him feel more at ease.
The words fellNext, the sword box behind Qiu Linyuan suddenly opened, and a crisp sword cry sounded. Qiu Linyuan rose into the air, stepped on the flying sword, and walked with the sword.
Li Daoyan took out a compass from his arms. Green light emerged from the compass, and a huge Bagua shadow appeared. Then his whole body rose into the sky, followed Qiu Linyuan, and disappeared into the sky.
"Don't worry, Shi'an. Mr. Li and Master Qiu will go together, and they will be ready to capture him and comfort the spirit of the deceased in heaven." Duan Qingyue said with relief.
